summary: Retrieves the status of the asynchronous job that a bulk users command queued
description: Retrieves the status of the asynchronous job that a bulk users command queued.

status.description: Current state of the batch job.

is_complete.description: Whether every job in the batch has finished.

total.description: Number of jobs in the batch.

pending.description: Number of jobs in the batch that have not yet succeeded.

description.description: Label assigned to the batch when it was created.

failures.description: Number of jobs in the batch that failed.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of when the batch was created.

complete_at.description: Unix timestamp of when every job in the batch finished. Null while the batch is still running.

success_at.description: Unix timestamp of when every job in the batch succeeded. Null if any job failed.

death_at.description: Unix timestamp of when a job in the batch exhausted its retries. Null when no job has died.

404.description: The batch was not found or has expired.
